Planning Document: docs/sepps/State Environmental Planning Policy (Housing) 2021 - NSW Legislation.pdf

Clause 3(a) - other (land_use_zoning): enabling the development of diverse housing types, including purpose-built rental housing

Clause 3(b) - other (land_use_zoning): encouraging the development of housing that will meet the needs of more vulnerable members of the community, including very low to moderate income households, seniors and people with a disability

Clause 3(c) - other (development_control): ensuring new housing development provides residents with a reasonable level of amenity

Clause 3(d) - other (land_use_zoning): promoting the planning and delivery of housing in locations where it will make good use of existing and planned infrastructure and services

Clause 3(e) - environmental_protection (environmental_protection): minimising adverse climate and environmental impacts of new housing development

Clause 3(f) - other (development_control): reinforcing the importance of designing housing in a way that reflects and enhances its locality

Clause 3(g) - other (land_use_zoning): supporting short-term rental accommodation as a home-sharing activity and contributor to local economies, while managing the social and environmental impacts from this use

Clause 3(h) - other (land_use_zoning): mitigating the loss of existing affordable rental housing
